training_call_chain.2_grid_and_iterations: dmg.core.data.data.create_training_grid() computes n_iter_ep (number of mini-batches per epoch) based on dataset size, batch_size, and rho
training_call_chain.4_batch_sampler: dmg.core.data.samplers.hydro_sampler.HydroSampler.get_training_sample() calls random_index(ngrid, nt, (batch_size, rho), warmup) to sample random (basin, time_start) pairs
training_call_chain.5_data_subsetting: select_subset() slices [warmup + rho, batch_size, features] tensor for forcing (x) and target (y)
training_call_chain.6_model_forward: dmg.models.model_handler.ModelHandler.forward() calls dmg.models.delta_models.dpl_model.DplModel.forward() which runs NN parameterizer -> Physics Model
training_call_chain.7_loss_computation: ModelHandler.calc_loss() calls _trim(output, target) which removes warmup timesteps (output[warmup:], target[warmup:]), then computes loss via criterion (e.g., NseBatchLoss, KgeBatchLoss, MSELoss)
